_about: T-453: the planner. step on every record = how many of the story's steps are done before it is reachable; show a record when the save has done at least that many (count the done_flag of each step in planner_story.json, bits as profile_layout explains). Every trainer a map's scripts battle, with our class and name, party (species and level), and flag (set once beaten; bits as profile_layout explains). A rival battle is three rows, one per starter the rival may hold (rival_starter); its name is the save's. boss marks leaders, rivals, the REVIEW BOARD, the champion and CORPUS's boss; rematch, a second round after the story. Left out on purpose: every place the game means to be found by playing, the islands only a ticket reaches, what lives in DOLDRUM CAVE, hidden items, fixed encounters, the GUIDE and the UNDERSTANDINGS, the NOTEBOOK and its books, and any line of the game's text.
